 Board Approval Date: Both the leadership transition and Dr. Pinto’s board appointment were approved on August 12, 2026. [...] ## Neumora Therapeutics Announces CEO Transition and Q2 2026 Earnings

Neumora Therapeutics, Inc.  (NASDAQ:NMRA)   NMRA (NASDAQ:NMRA)    , headquartered at 260 Arsenal Place, Suite 1, Watertown, Massachusetts 02472, revealed two major updates in its August 14, 2026 filing. Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., who was serving as President, was named Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Paul L. Berns. Mr. Berns assumed the role of Executive Chairperson of the Board of Directors. This leadership change was effective as of August 14, 2026, referred to as the "Transition Date" in the filing. [...] The Board of Directors approved this leadership transition on August 12, 2026, two days prior to its effective date. Concurrently, the Board appointed Dr. Pinto as a Class III director, with a term expiring at the 2029 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Dr. Pinto will continue in this role until a successor is elected or until his earlier death, resignation, or removal. His prior professional background is detailed in the company’s Definitive Proxy Statement on Schedule 14A filed April 17, 2026.
